title: Suspected cancer: recognition and referral (NICE guideline NG12) — urological cancers
publisher: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
claims: Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral (for an appointment within 2 weeks) for bladder cancer if they are aged 45 and over and have unexplained visible haematuria without urinary tract infection.
The same referral applies if they are aged 45 and over and have visible haematuria that persists or recurs after successful treatment of urinary tract infection.
Refer people aged 60 and over with unexplained non-visible haematuria and either dysuria or a raised white cell count on a blood test.
The recommendations apply to bladder and upper tract urothelial carcinoma.
